name: Tenshi ni Dakarete Shousetsu "Tenshi ni Dakishimerarete" Yori
original_name: 天使に抱かれて　小説「天使に抱きしめられて」より
source:
Main character is an angel apprentice who is given task to find the true love on the Earth to become a full-fledged angel. Protagonist borrows a certain male body and starts his quest. He tries domination, destruction, coexistence, dedication, subordination and even has relations with a demonic woman - will that all help him find true love?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名天使见习生。
为了成为独当一面的天使，他接到任务：在地球上寻找真爱。
他借用某具男性躯体展开探索。
他尝试支配、毁灭、共存、奉献、服从，甚至与一名恶魔女性发生关系——这一切能帮他找到真爱吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
